recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-20905 unless a future work-group decision changes Mapping Language semantics for auto-created choice elements.
issue_request: FHIR-20905 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked how mapping rules should handle a target element with a choice of possible types when a transform or dependent rule auto-creates the target instance. The accepted resolution was to document that the engine raises an error when the target instance type cannot be determined and to recommend explicit create().
initial_application: Git commit 379e1fd5fa6933531e474aa54c53a900c53897bb, with a FHIR-20905 subject, added the requested paragraph and create() example to source/mapping-language.html. Current blame still attributes the relevant Type Wrangling lines to that commit.
additional_context: source/mapping-language.html is part of the current build navigation via source/hierarchy.xml and is referenced by the StructureMap introduction. Current target-transform prose also says auto-created elements are an error when primitive or when there is more than one possible type. Zulip searches found only a FHIR-I block-vote notice and a later mapping-framework issue status list; Confluence searches found no FHIR-20905 references or conflicting minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current source already reflects the Jira resolution.
